notes.title: Boring Man v1.2.7.4 is now available
notes.notes:
[h1]Dev log[/h1]
Another small update focused on stopping cheating. Unfortunately, a handful of cheaters have been persistently using the non-Steam version to avoid bans so I decided to scrap it. This is pretty disappointing because I don't like forcing players to use the Steam version but they have ruined it for everyone else.

With that being said, I've heavily updated Anti-Hacks Enforcer. It is, however, unstable and widely untested and that will have to be the public's job since there are thousands of factors where it can go wrong. So for the first few days it will simply silently log if it thinks someone is cheating, and once I think I have heavily reduced the false positives I will enable kicking. If you get kicked and not banned and you weren't cheating, report it to me with what you were exactly doing before you were kicked.

If you are a server host and used the non-Steam version, it's no problem, you can still use it. But to run the game you must set "Dedicated" to "ON" in the INI file otherwise it will crash talking about the Steam API.

Get it here: http://spasmangames.com/boringman/

Also good news for anyone previously banned, the slate has been cleared and you are unbanned now. Unless you were such a problem and I had to ban your Steam ID from the game, in which case I just applied those Steam IDs to the ban lists.

[h1]Added[/h1]

- Added “VotePercentage” to the INI file settings. Lets you set the percentage of yes votes needed to pass a vote.
- Added “VotePlayersNeeded” to the INI file settings. Lets you set the needed number of players to start a vote ban. Ignored by map votes.
- Added “TestAHE” to the INI file settings. Leave it at 0 to completely turn off the experimental anti-cheat but log info. Change to 1 to only kick players (not banned) and log info. Change to 2 to fully kick and ban players and log info. This option will go away and the new code will be fully integrated when testing is done and it is stable.

[h1]Changed[/h1]

- Server bans are now fully based on Steam profiles instead of IP addresses
- You can still use IP addresses to ban if needed but they need to be manually added to the ban text file for the server.
- Anti-Hacks Enforcer is testing more powerful code. Use TestAHE to turn it on or off or only allow it to kick players instead of ban.
- You can still use the non-Steam version for dedicated server hosting. Download it from my site: http://spasmangames.com/boringman/
- You will now get a crash if the Steam API isn’t running the game. Restart your Steam client when this happens. (This happens when your Premium disappears)
- This crash is avoided if you are running in dedicated server mode.

[h1]Fixed[/h1]

- Fixed damage numbers occasionally not reporting accurately
- Fixed Revolver not being able to alt-fire while reloading
- Fixed a crash that happened if you closed the game at the initialization screen

notes.notes:
[h1]Dev Log[/h1]
One more final tiny hotfix to take down more auto clicking exploits and to add a feature i've been pining for.

notes.title: Boring Man v1.2.7.2 is now available - Thank you update 🎄
notes.notes:
[h1]Dev Log[/h1]

So for those that don't know, my new game [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=774112780]TUNNEL DIVERS[/url] was greenlit recently. It only took 2 weeks That was FAST, and I owe it to the Boring Man community. So while I said I don't want to update as much anymore, this update is a token of my gratitude. Thank you all for supporting me, I didn't think my dumb games were that important to you that you'd actually spend the time to vote yes for me. Now I can really crack down on this new game without any obstacles because I know it will be great.

I always wanted to do a holiday theme update, so I figured this would be my last chance to do so for this game. Most of the update is just aesthetic. Changes your hats, some scenery but its nothing too large. But I hope it gets you in the mood anyways because winter holidays are /comfy/

I also kept a close eye on weapon feedback because I can't really help myself and thought I'd throw the community a bone there too. But don't get use to it. I'm sure you will all find something new to complain about.

The buzzer has been labeled the new "spam" weapon now that its good, so I altered it in ways to reduce said spam. The gravity will now require some player aim, and even some thought into how the blades will bounce.

The revolver and double barrel have suffered from auto clickers for a little too long, so I did away with that by making the fire rate of both human. For those who liked the rapid fire revolver clicking, you can still use its new alt fire, Rapid Fire. It will rapidly fire the revolver just as fast as you use to click it, but at the cost of accuracy.

My gratitude got you to squeeze another update outta me, so here you go. Thank you a lot for helping me live my dream.

[h1]Winter Event[/h1]

- Somewhere Land is feeling a little more cheerful! I mean, its still in turmoil but you know.
- Temporary holiday hats!
- Survival chests are now survival presents!
- It’s snowing everywhere!! I mean everywhere!! In the desert? UNDERGROUND? What.
- And more!


[h1]Fixed[/h1]

- Fixed muleslapper sound bug
- Fixed a crash if you clicked a team before the map finished loading


[h1]Weapons[/h1]

- Increased double barrel reload time
- Decreased double barrel fire rate
- Decreased revolver fire rate
- New Revolver Alt Fire: Rapid Fire
- Buzzer projectiles are now heavily affected by gravity


[h1]Boring Editor v1.5[/h1]

- Changed how saving/loading works. You can now save and load bmap files directly, bmapsaves are no more.
- You can still load bmapsaves if needed in the file menu. F10 key will still need to be used when loading bmapsave files.
- Added the ability to use the arrow keys as a mouse wheel
(Recompiling not necessary, but always recommended.)

notes.title: Boring Man v1.2.7.1 is now available
notes.notes:
Devlog:
Windows played a cool prank on me and deleted all of my BMAPSAVE files, which is used to edit maps. I had to decrypt and load the BMAP files (the map files you load in-game) into the map editor manually to recover them.

All of the maps are still precisely the same, but it juggled their md5 hash values which are used to check if you have the correct map for the server, so I need to push a version number to make sure everyone has these newly compiled maps.

All the other stuff may or may not be already in the previous version, they are just in the change log for documentation purposes.

Also like I said hundreds of times, I will continue bug fix updates as long as needed, so if I hear "OMGGG YOURE STILL UPDATING" I will unpin a grenade and leave it in your adventure time onesie.

Changelog:
- Added being able to use Ctrl + V for text input while in the menu
- Removed XP gain from capturing flags and control points
- Removed the ability to get achievements on custom maps
- Fixed players not being limited to level 100 correctly
- Fixed the TDM flag giving an additional point if you cap it at the end of the round
- Fixed ‘Cool Island Song ‘and ‘Zoned’ achievements not unlocking correctly in some instances
- Fixed the random loadout button not working correctly if you click it before spawning
- Fixed the random loadout button not spawning Old Weapons and the jetpack correctly
- The random loadout button will now default you to the “Custom” loadout when selected
- Fixed the suicide vest going off the next round in TDM if activated before round end
- Fixed a few bits of misinformation in the menu
- Fixed hidden spikes on The Man side in Dyson City

notes.title: Boring Man v1.2.7 is now available
notes.notes:
[h1]Dev Log[/h1]
It's finally here lads. The last major update.

I added a bit of content since people were wanting some so much, but its not a lot. I also tried to buff as many weapons as I could without thinking I would break them.

This does not mean I will refuse to update anything after this. Any future updates are possible, but they will be very tiny and only have bug fixes. No more content or changes or anything will be added.

Also "Dyson Pizza" won the billboard contest! It should now appear on the rooftops map. Congrats to Holy M. [url=http://i.imgur.com/uds32U0.jpg]Da results[/url]

I also might hop on to play tommorrow and stream it, lemme know if thats interesting.

[h1]Added[/h1]

- Added new map: Tutorial….?
- Added 5 new Premium hats. I’m your new favorite developer.
- Added an option to disable the mouse wheel (you can now use it to change weapons)
- Added a server option to disable the TDM control point
- Added a server option to enable Overtime
- Added /steam <player name> and /id <player name> to REMOTE CONSOLE commands.
- Added a (very) basic technical help section in the main menu
- Added the ability to disable the anti-cheat for your server
- Added video option to disable the “ghosts” in Climb mode
- Added some more social media buttons for following me
- Added the ability to disable the social media buttons, in bm_settings.ini under “SocialMedia”
- Added a random weapon option in the weapon selection menu. My lucky machine.

[h1]Changed[/h1]

- Team Deathmatch: A control point will now spawn in the middle of the map if a round takes too long. If a team captures it, they will win the round. You capture it much more quickly than a Take Over control point.
- Capture the Flag: Autobalance will now ignore flag carriers
- Capture the Flag: Overtime will be initiated if either flag is not in base when time is up
- Levels: Level is now capped out at level 100. You can no longer find gold tickets when leveling up.
- Levels: You can now earn XP on custom maps, mutators and with bots without restriction.
- Gold Tickets: Gold tickets are now found when the match ends (matches must be longer then 6 min). The longer the match, the more the chance increases.
- Gold Tickets: Gold tickets can still be found in Survival chests for the same chance as before, however it still must be a stock map.
- Levels/Gold Tickets: XP weekends have been replaced with Gold ticket weekends
- Zombrains: Zomikazes can no longer explode during grace period
- Zombrains: Removed speed increase from Zomikazes
- Survival/Zombrains: AI enemies now have a hard set grace period of 2 seconds
- Bots: New name generator and extended bot chatter
- Replaced the “Thats All Folks” achievement with “The Beanjo Maneuver” achievement

[h1]Fixed[/h1]

- Fixed not being able to use mouse wheel while creating load outs
- Fixed the team select menu getting stuck if you clicked a team you can’t join
- Fixed grenade throws being delayed after firing a weapon with a slow fire rate
- Fixed not being able to open the weapon menu while dead in Survival
- Fixed stats page saying you had 1 less achievement
- Fixed being able to hold the jetpack, skateboard, etc like a grenade
- Fixed the boomerang flying forever if the thrower dies
- Fixed being able to scope with weapons that don’t have scopes
- Fixed being able to fire infinite fusion cannon rounds
- Fixed low health sound looping when max health mutator is under 25
- Fixed being able to shoot through some walls with sniper rounds
- Fixed the host being hit by the chat flood protection
- Fixed zombies in Zombrains not being able to be tased
- Fixed being tased not stopping a skateboard
- Fixed grenades having recoil when you have the hand cannon equipped
- Fixed being able to charge the bow and fusion cannon while throwing a grenade
- Fixed the stats screen experiencing lag if you have a large amount of play time

[h1]Maps[/h1]

- Altered some areas on many maps to get rid of camping spots (or make them less effective)
- Boring Lake now has a sky walk between each base and the middle tower
- Added TDM flags to each map.


[h1]Weapons[/h1]

- All SMGs and Uzis (Except Power SMG and Dual SMGs) no longer have weight, much like pistols and melee weapons.
- Power SMG: Decreased projectile speed
- Power SMG: Reduced weight
- Bow: Decreased arrow pull back speed, not pulling back all the way will always give you low damage
- Buzzer: Slightly increased accuracy
- Plasma Shot: Increased damage
- Light SMG: Increased projectile speed
- Muleslapper: Increased reload speed
- Acid Gun: Slightly increased damage
- Rail Gun: Increased fire rate
- Blaster: Slightly increased damage to all firing modes
- Dual Pistols: Increased fire rate
- Magic: Increased damage
- Taser: Reduced reload time
- Dual SMGs: Reduced weight

[h1]Boring Editor v1.4[/h1]

- Added the ability to add TDM flag spawns
- You should not have to recompile your maps, but its recommended.

notes.title: Vote for your favorite billboard!
notes.notes:
After careful judging and consideration, I have selected the 3 billboards below as my favorites. Please vote for them below:

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSc2l9T6dnntRmWTH6vMk1dkJE8H9D8JSLyDuEve_nBzPBh30g/viewform?c=0&w=1

notes.title: Billboard Art Contest! Win free Premium!
notes.notes:
EDIT: This contest is over.

Hi,

So if you haven't noticed yet, theres a billboard on Dyson Rooftops thats looking a little [url=http://i.imgur.com/WZqRXet.jpg]messed up[/url], thanks to vandalism throughout the years. The city is looking to get it replaced and they need your help!

Here's the billboard template: http://i.imgur.com/CUw4B1a.jpg

Send your submissions to my email: spasman@spasmangames.com
Either attach your art to the email or post the image link. (I suggest using puush or imgur). Remember to also include your in-game name so I know who you are.

Submission deadline is the same as the suggestion one, 8/31/2016

I will personally pick my top 3 submissions. The top 3 submissions will get a free Premium code. Then you, the people, will vote on the 3 submissions and the voted winner will get their billboard put on the Rooftops map and get into the Hall of Fame (in the credits). Wow!! Eternally cemented in B-Man history!!!

All accepted billboards will be added to a photo album on the Spasman Games facebook page for everyone to see. (at the end of the contest)
https://www.facebook.com/SpasmanGames/

Rules:
[code]
1. Use the template, keep the image size the same (320x240). Send it as a png, NOT jpg. Crappy compressed images or a photo of a hand drawn image (you will need to scan it) will not be accepted. It's okay if you mess up, ill let you know what you need to fix before accepting.

2. Racism, homophobia, sexism, general hatred towards someone, etc. will not be accepted, or even uploaded to the photo album, and I will shame you over email if needed.

3. Don't attach your stupid game suggestions to the billboard email or I will ignore it, please keep it on the forum or in a separate email at least. Sorry, it's just really annoying to have to wade through shit suggestions any time i interact with any of you.

4. Multiple submissions and submission edits are fine, but you can only pick one of them to enter, and i won't decide for you.
[/code]

notes.title: The Future of Boring Man, Part 2
notes.notes:
So some of you are saying a lot of dumb crap, so I'm guessing I wasn't clear on a few things.

[h1]"Abandoning"[/h1]
This has been a nice word to see that makes me feel good and I'm real glad how grateful some of you are. The game is not being abandoned, a game CAN'T be abandoned if its finished. Does a construction worker abandon a house when he's done building it? Ridiculous.

Valve and Minecraft must have unfortunately raised the next generation of gamers to be entitled because apparently some of you are convinced that a developer has to anchor themselves to update their games for eternity. I actually like to finish my games, so if you don't like that, theres a whole list of Steam games that are right up your alley, labeled Early Access games.

[h1]My involvement[/h1]
I don't plan on interacting with the community as much when the update is out, but the servers will always be up as long as people are playing.

[h1]Sequel[/h1]
I have no plans for a direct sequel. Maybe a silly spin off game on mobile or something, but I don't see a full fledged sequel being possible. 

Until GM gets server/VPS friendly features, or i somehow have the energy to learn a new language, don't expect a sequel or any more multiplayer focused games from me in the future.

[h1]Rewrite[/h1]
Some of you have also been rudely demanding I rewrite the game like its an easy feat. If I wanted to do that, I'd just make a sequel instead, but you just read why I don't want to do that. Secondly, the game isn't very popular and doesn't seem worth the effort. On top of that, the small community it has doesn't even seem to appreciate my efforts anyways, so whats the point?

[h1]Updating[/h1]
If there is a game breaking bug discovered in the future, it's not like I won't be too stubborn to fix it. It's not a decision set in stone, so if you're worried about some exploit being found, I will fix it if I think it really needs fixing. 

[h1]Premium[/h1]
Really depressing how I have to mention this but Premium will never be free. It's not a thing I'm trying to keep away from 10 year olds without a credit card, its a thank you to those who support me. If you want to give me $5, then thank you, have some hats. Thats it. You don't need Premium to enjoy the game.

Anyhow thats all the explaining I'm going to do. If you're still not happy after this, then you're probably not the kind of player I want following my work anyways. Stay gold.

edit: I know there are plenty of you out there who do support my work, and thanks, I know you're there. This game has just made me pretty grumpy the past year and I don't mean to lump you in with the others.

notes.title: The Future of Boring Man - OTSC
notes.notes:
Today with somber apathy, I would like to announce the next update (1.2.7) (and any small hot fixes immediately following it) will be the FINAL release.

What this means is I will no longer update the game and it will be the final product.

This game is pretty old. It will turn 5 years old in a few months and updating it at this point is like beating a dead horse. I would like to move on to other projects, however to work without any interruption I will need to free myself from this game.

However unlike a lot of developers, instead of silently distancing myself from the game, I would like to leave it with a big fix up.

I will open a pinned thread in the Steam forums, and you are all welcome to post bug fixes and suggestions. Obviously, a lot of suggestions and bug fixes will be rejected, but I will try my best to at least provide closure as to why they are rejected. Please don't email me because my email is delayed because I have it forwarded to my gmail account and I'd like for everyone to be in one place.

I understand there are a few glaring problems, but the work to resolve them is just not worth it in my opinion. If you have any questions, just visit the thread suggestions linked below.

I have no plans to shut down my servers and the server list. As long as people are playing, the servers will be up. I simply just want to move away from this project as a developer and work on something new.

Link to thread:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/346120/discussions/0/352788552259082614/

The deadline for suggestions is 8/31/2016. I will take bug reports up until release

notes.title: Boring Man v1.2.6 is now available
notes.notes:
[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/Clx3S7NWgAAknnu.jpg[/img]
[i]By robo_runner on Twitter[/i]

[h1]Dev Log[/h1]
This update's focus is on reducing player toxicity. Some of you have been abusing the chat binds quite a bit and the feature was almost removed entirely but I was talked out of it. Theres also flood protection as well.

Weird unicode characters have also been stripped from names and clan tags. This was not only annoying and made me cringe to see edgy usernames, but it also messed with Game Maker's ability to log the chat and sending commands to the server.

The process to make levels less valuable has started. Instead of seeing them on the scoreboard, you now must click on their name. I'm not dumb and can tell someones cracked the save encryption, and I expected it. I'm just starting to move the game towards a point where levels and saves won't really matter that much except to the player that has it.

Lastly, some more weapon balancing. Handcannon has a new gimmick that should make it a less spammy weapon. Damage fall off has been increased, making most other weapons less spammy as well. Hopefully that will suffice the hand cannon whining.

Also Premium is on the sale, 50% off. Won't get much cheaper then that.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/346170/

[h1]Added[/h1]
- Added a new key “Show/Hide Chat”. Toggles the chat window when F2 is pressed.
- Added a DPS display in the shooting range

[h1]Fixed/Changed[/h1]
- General: Chat binding character limit reduced to 25 characters and can only use it 2 times every 8 seconds instead of 3
- General: Added chat flood protection for every 8 seconds
- General: Removed some debug info
- General: Removed leveling up in chat and levels are only shown when you click on their name in the scoreboard
- General: Changed default vote keys to F10 and F11
     * If you played before this update, you will still have F11 and F12 as your vote keys. this new binding is for new players.
- General: Vote bans are temporarily disabled if too many failed votes occur
- General: Increased the amount of players needed in the server for a vote ban
- General: Player names, chat binds & clan tags are now stripped of most unicode
- General: Fixed being able to roll + use the grapple hook during a taunt
- Zombrains: Position on scoreboard is now sorted by kills
- Survival: Position on scoreboard is now sorted by kills
- Team Deathmatch: Fixed grace period not running when players respawn
- Team Deathmatch: Fixed poison not resetting after a TDM round

[h1]Weapons[/h1]
- Handcannon: The mouse cursor now has aim kick back when fired
- Shotguns: Slightly increased range
- Most Bullet Projectiles: Increased amount of damage fall off
- Power Rifle: Decreased projectile speed
- Power Rifle: Removed pushback
- Chain Gun: Increased damage

notes.title: Small hotfix for servers
notes.notes:
I updated with just a small hot fix for servers.

[list]
    [*] Anti-cheat was banning players for no reason if the server was running at low FPS. This has been fixed and tested.

    [*] Occasionally, servers will have a map corruption error when the map isnt actually corrupted, thus stopping the server for no reason. The server will automatically restart when this error happens. So if your server enters a restart loop, your maps probably ARE actually corrupted. If you have logging enabled, the error will appear there instead to confirm.

    [*] You may have noticed banned.txt is now bm_settings.ini_banned.txt. This is for running multiple servers with different config files, so each server has its own ban list. Not as convienient as a global ban list, but it was causing file writing issues.

[*] Lastly, you may have also noticed symbols at the end of IP address bans. These symbols help you determine what ban method was used quickly.

[code]@ = Anti cheat ban
$ = Vote ban
None = Banned by server owner[/code]

IP addresses with $ at the end of them are automatically removed every hour or so. You can use this to your advantage to also temporarily ban players yourself. Just ban them, then open the ban list file and add the $ at the end of their IP address yourself.

IP addresses with the @ are NOT automatically removed. They are merely there to tell you the anti-cheat took action against someone. I suggest investigating each issue then deleting the @ to "permanently" ban them or delete the whole IP address if you believe it was false. That way you can keep track of new bans that happened recently.
[/list]

This update isn't MANDATORY but its recommended. People will still be able to play on your servers if you don't update right away.

Thats it. Sorry if you found this news post disappointing. [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eFJWrDCeOa0]Have a dancing pumpkin man to feel better.[/url]

notes.title: Boring Man v1.2.5 is now available
notes.notes:
[h1]DevLog[/h1]

[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/Ci8sDPwVAAEeRBM.jpg:large[/img]
[i]Made by Abaddon[/i]

So after mingling with the veteran players for a little bit, I balanced a lot of the weapons for the end game better. So if any of these changes make you mad, well, blame your fellow player.

Shotguns are vastly different now so you might have to re-learn how to use them.

Musket has a fancy new toy attached to it now to make it a little more viable. The damage and reload speeds have been drastically changed to reflect more like a real world musket.

Lastly, the Shooting Range is available! Feel free to share your best times and see if you can get the best. I'm only able to get 1:10...


[h1]Added[/h1]

- Added Shooting Range area, that comes with a time trial target mode.
- Added kill feeds to remote console “API”

[h1]Fixed/Changed[/h1]

- General: Fixed Weapon Select menu opening and closing while typing a message
- General: Fixed explosions being able to heal in some cases
- General: Can now see Zombrains money on scoreboard
- General: You now must be level 35 or higher to start votebans
- General: Added "$" at the end of the IP address of vote bans in banned.txt, "@" for anti-cheat bans
- General: Yes vote threshold reduced to 60%
- General: Added mouse wheel to selecting weapons in weapon menu
- General: Fixed reload sounds not following players
- Maps: Added spikes to the sides of Factory

[h1]Weapons[/h1]

- Musket: Increased damage drastically, reduced reload speed drastically
- Musket: Added bayonet as alt. fire
- Long Rifle: Damage from last patch increase was a bug, damage officially increased from original stat (not as much as before)
- All Shotguns (Excluding Old Shotgun): Projectiles been changed to special shotgun projectiles , which have no damage fall off but have very limited range
- Double Barrel: Increased blast spread, reduced total ammo
- Sawn Off: Reduced blast spread
- Pump Action: Reduced total ammo
- Trench Gun: Increased total ammo
- Keymaster Alt. Fire: Increased blast spread
- Keymaster Alt. Fire: Reduced fire rate, slightly reduced damage
- Scoped Rifle: Reduced damage
- Light AR: Reduced damage, slightly increased fire rate
- Blaster (Spread Type): Reduced blast spread, increased damage, reduced fire rate
- Blaster (Flame Shot): Increased damage, reduced fire rate
- Gas Launcher: Increased fire rate, total ammo and magazine size

notes.title: Testing cloud saves.
notes.notes:
Hi. I enabled auto cloud saving for the game. It worked for me, but I'm not super confident it works for everyone. So if folks can test for me, I'd appreiciate it. If you're not good at computers, please ignore this.

1. Restart Steam

2. Back up your save data to somewhere safe. It's all in the %localappdata%\BoringManGame folder. This is important! Your save data might save level 1 data to Valve's servers by accident if you freshly install the game on another computer.

3. Run B-Man once, then close it. This should put your save data in the cloud save.

4. Install Steam on another computer 

5. Install a fresh copy of b-man and run it on there. Preferably, I'd like you to delete any old save files you may have on that computer to greatly help with testing.

6. Confirm your save file and settings (like your in-game name) have transfered over to the new computer without you doing anything.

notes.title: Lend me a hand! (Beta Branch)
notes.notes:
There is a beta branch I configured in Steam. I compiled the game differently to see if it would make Game Maker behave better with save files. Unfortunately, this compile cant see the Maps/Backgrounds/Tiles folder at where they are currently installed and it would take some ground work to fix that.

So I figured I'd reach out to the more tech savvy to switch to this beta branch, manually move the files to the correct location and play with that installation for a little while, before I'd start doing work on that. I want to see if this installation set up is any good before proceeding any further with it. You can then post in the forums if anything weird happens.

To opt into the beta:
1. Right click B-Man in your library
2. Click Properties, then the Betas tab
3. Click the drop down and select "alternate", then Close
4. Re-install the game.

The beta has 0 game play differences, it is simply a different file set up. You should still be able to play with anyone with or without the beta build. After you install the beta branch, it should look like this: http://i.imgur.com/tIAZVOM.png

(if it doesnt, you will need to uninstall the game, restart Steam, then reinstall the game)

Now for the tricky part. You will need to go into your Boring Man Steam install folder and take all the folders in there (except BoringEditor) and move it to the BoringManGame AppData folder. If you don't do this, you'll get a "map not found" error if you try to play on a server. If you have no idea what I just said, I'd just sit this one out.

If you installed the beta version but no longer want it, simply folllow the beta install instructions again but instead select "default" instead of "alternate" to revert the beta installation.

If any of you can do this, especially any of you who's had their save erased in the past, please do. If your save has been erased from the past few days (i said DAYS, not weeks or months), please comment below which Windows version you are using, and check out the Technical FAQ here to see if you can recover it: http://steamcommunity.com/app/346120/discussions/0/485623406944171961/

Thanks
-Spasman

EDIT:

[h1]**DO NOT PUT YOUR CUSTOM MAPS/BACKGROUNDS/TILES WHILE USING THIS VERSION**[/h1]

It will get deleted when you start the game. Instead, three folders will generate in the AppData folder. Place your custom maps in a folder called "CustomMaps". Then place any custom backgrounds/tiles you may have for your custom maps in their respective CustomTiles/CustomBackgrounds folders.

I updated the alternate branch. The beta now properly saves maps/backgrounds/tiles to the AppData folder automatically, so you should no longer need to do that part. It also deletes them before copying them again. (The files are now built inside the game)

So I figured I'd reach out to the more tech savvy to switch to this beta branch, manually move the files to the correct location and play with that installation for a little while, before I'd start doing work on that. I want to see if this installation set up is any good before proceeding any further with it. You can then post in the forums if anything weird happens.

To opt into the beta:
1. Right click B-Man in your library
2. Click Properties, then the Betas tab
3. Click the drop down and select "alternate", then Close
4. Re-install the game.

The beta has 0 game play differences, it is simply a different file set up. You should still be able to play with anyone with or without the beta build. After you install the beta branch, it should look like this: http://i.imgur.com/tIAZVOM.png

(if it doesnt, you will need to uninstall the game, restart Steam, then reinstall the game)

Now for the tricky part. You will need to go into your Boring Man Steam install folder and take all the folders in there (except BoringEditor) and move it to the BoringManGame AppData folder. If you don't do this, you'll get a "map not found" error if you try to play on a server. If you have no idea what I just said, I'd just sit this one out.

If you installed the beta version but no longer want it, simply folllow the beta install instructions again but instead select "default" instead of "alternate" to revert the beta installation.

If any of you can do this, especially any of you who's had their save erased in the past, please do. If your save has been erased from the past few days (i said DAYS, not weeks or months), please comment below which Windows version you are using, and check out the Technical FAQ here to see if you can recover it: http://steamcommunity.com/app/346120/discussions/0/485623406944171961/

Thanks
-Spasman

EDIT:

[h1]**DO NOT PUT YOUR CUSTOM MAPS/BACKGROUNDS/TILES WHILE USING THIS VERSION**[/h1]

It will get deleted when you start the game. Instead, three folders will generate in the AppData folder. Place your custom maps in a folder called "CustomMaps". Then place any custom backgrounds/tiles you may have for your custom maps in their respective CustomTiles/CustomBackgrounds folders.

I updated the alternate branch. The beta now properly saves maps/backgrounds/tiles to the AppData folder automatically, so you should no longer need to do that part. It also deletes them before copying them again. (The files are now built inside the game)

notes.title: State of the servers + 25% OFF!
notes.notes:
Hi there. Thanks to everyone who has been playing this game. The Markiplier community has really seemed to take a liking of it, but maybe a little bit too much... you're hugging everything to death! It's probably pretty frustrating not being able to get into full servers.

If you don't know, I'm not exactly a full dev team. I made this game by myself and run most of the servers, by myself. The past few days I've been asking friends to host for me to accommodate all of you, but this is mostly all on one misanthropic single male's shoulders (and budget) at the moment. This game went from 60 to 800 players over night.

I just want to say I'm also proud of the veterans teaching the new players their tricks and tips and hosting servers themselves as well. You all really stepped up and made this not the big disaster I was expecting. Thank you.

So just as a reminder, this game did not always have nearly 1000 players daily. The population will go down in the next few days as Markiplier's Boring Man video slowly falls off his recent video list. So if the game is unplayable for you now, I highly recommend keeping it installed at least for a few days and check back later. I think you'll find the game to be much more pleasant and chill.

And if you think port forwarding is hard, well, be lucky you weren't PC gaming in the 90s ¯\_(ツ)_/¯

Edit:

notes.title: Boring Man v1.2.0 is now available
notes.notes:
[h1]WARNING: SAVEPOCALYPSE INCOMING[/h1]
This version will delete your current save if it was generated in an earlier version

[u]Added[/u]
Added major changes to Survival Mode, see below.
Added AFK kicking. Players who are afk (no keystrokes or mouse movement) for 2 minutes are sent to spectator, another 2 minutes and they disconnect
Added 10 new weapons
Added 10 new achievements
Added 6 new Premium hats
Added base equipment, the Teleporter
Added new map: Throne Room (throne.bmap)
Added new climb map: Keys Climb (clb_key.bmap)
Added Golden Tickets, see below
Added XP numbers any time you earn XP
Added new bm_settings.ini entry, PlayerVoting. Set to 0 to disable player voting
Added admin commands /voting 0 and /voting 1 to manage server voting
Added Delete Save Data button in Stats screen

[u]Survival Mode[/u]
Enemies are now based off of B-Man lore. Strong enemies sometimes appear.
Added “Vices”. Vices appear in chests occasionally when a new wave begins. They can boost your stats and give you certain abilities.
Hold the C key (flag throw) to open the Vices screen to see what you collected and what the vices do.
“Spasman” can now be encountered in Survival mode.

[u]Golden Tickets[/u]
Golden tickets allow you to select your golden weapons
Golden tickets have a 14% drop rate every time you level up, after you unlock every weapon
Golden tickets can also be found rarely in chests in Survival Mode after you reach lvl 80
You do not need Premium to earn golden tickets.



[u]Fixed/Changed[/u]
Fixed reviving in Zombrains mode not setting your max health correctly
Fixed Survival mode not starting correctly in 1 minute
Bots, survival enemies and zombie AI no longer give out XP after reaching level 80
Forced borderless windowed mode.
Updated Game Maker IDE, crashes may happen. Report them to spasman@spasmangames.com
Fixed a typo in Max Life mutator description
Fixed the freeze timer not resetting after a map change.
Fixed damage numbers appearing even when a hit doesn’t register
Players can now be overhealed to 200 instead of 150
Fixed the ammo hud showing up for the wrench
Fixed Freeze Timer not resetting after map change
Fixed the laser trap’s audio acting sketchy
Bots can now use third slot weapons
Bots can now repair and attack generators
Starting total XP is now set to 2500
Total XP requirement increase after leveling up has been reduced
Changed save file encryption in an attempt to stop save corruption
Glass is more fragile and no longer block bullets or rockets
Players who call for votes are no longer anonymous (voting is still anonymous)
Increased voting threshold to 76%
Team changing/spectator cooldown added
Changed dedicated server admin name

[u]Maps[/u]
Added a ladder under each base in Arena
Added tunnels to each generator in Dyson Sewers
Put some obstructions in the middle of Muleslapper MFG. (Factory)
Changed Zombrains weapons around on each map
Added teleporters to various maps
Climb maps are even easier!

[u]Weapons[/u]
Grapple Hook now detaches if player takes damage.
Reduced push back on Assault Rifle
Reduced fire rate on Blaster (Shotgun mode)
Increased damage of the Sawn Off
Fusion cannon projectiles now have gravity
Crossbow now has a delayed ‘bullet’ drop
Increased damage on crossbow
Increased fire rate on crossbow
Increased damage on Tranq Gun
Increased throw power on Tomahawks
Increased weight on the Pump Action
Increased push back on the auto shotgun. Whee!

[u]Map Editor[/u]
Added Teleporter and Chest Spawn assets
Updated WeaponHolo/NPC weapon selection
Added info dialogues to assets with assignable IDs
Added “beta” assets, doors and machine gun placements
Removed Workshop options

notes.title: Welcome! Welcome to Ticket to Paradise!
notes.notes:
[img]http://spasmangames.com/images/paradise/1.png[/img]

[h1]Thank You![/h1]
Thank you for your reservation! You are about embark on a vacation for a life time!

Somewhere Land Resort only cares about YOUR satisfaction! Please, before your trip, read about our wonderful attractions and amenities below.



[h1]Spectacular Shopping for your Armanent Needs[/h1]
Dyson City Armanents provides the best firearms and weapons Somewhere Land has to offer!

After a relaxing day on the beach, perhaps you would like to shop for your new favorite weapon for self defense against those pesky locals!

10 of our newest weapons are available to ALL of our guests! Here is a taste...

[img]http://spasmangames.com/images/paradise/2.png[/img]

The long rifle is a burst fire rifle, capable of taking out enemies from a far with a rapid fire capability!

[img]http://spasmangames.com/images/paradise/3.png[/img]

The boomerang is an exotic oddity of a weapon, and always returns to its user when thrown!
However if you don't catch it when it returns.. well, lets just say resort staff are not resonsible for ANY casualities that happen from self-boomerang accidents.



[h1]Chances to win Golden Tickets[/h1]
If you ever thought your favorite weapon ever needed a little pizzaz, enter our sweepstakes to win golden tickets!

What are golden tickets you ask?

[img]http://spasmangames.com/images/paradise/4.png[/img]

If you thought the old, obsolete system of a random golden weapon was frustrating, then fear not, our new revamped system will let you, our precious guest, choose what golden weapon you unlock!

Golden tickets can be won with a 14% chance after leveling up! So if you win one, your weapon of choice will be quite a rarity...
Guests who are visiting our resort for free will be able to earn these tickets as much as the premium members!

[img]http://spasmangames.com/images/paradise/5.png[/img]

When you posess one or more golden tickets, head over to your weapons unlock screen to make your choice.

Weapon unlock of current guest censored. We care about guest privacy at Somewhereland Resorts!



[h1]New, exciting locale![/h1]
Get a tour to our newest location, The Man's Throne Room!

The Man is our peoples' largest threat to existence, but that won't stop us from profiting off of his place of residence!

[img]http://spasmangames.com/images/paradise/6.png[/img]

Explore the evil magician's home, with disturbing torture chambers and large statues dedicated to his evil presence!



[h1]Fun and games![/h1]
Take part of the new and improved Survival mode! Feel like the heroes of USC by battling against the forces of evil!

Survive wave after wave of The Man's minions, based from past experiences of USC fabled hero, Boring Man! The further you get, the enemies get tougher...

[img]http://spasmangames.com/images/paradise/7.png[/img]

Find treasure to boost your abilities! Sometimes they even carry our valuable golden tickets.... but only if you're an experienced, regular guest and have a level over 80!

[img]http://spasmangames.com/images/paradise/8.png[/img]

Alcohol and smokes can make your character do more damage, run faster, and have wacky abilities! You can check what items you have any time you want...

[img]http://spasmangames.com/images/paradise/9.png[/img]

Collecting multiple of the same item can stack! So having 2 bottles of Ale can increase your damage by 4.

On occasion, stronger staff members will jump into your match and try to put you under control if you're too good and need to be stopped!



[img]http://spasmangames.com/images/paradise/10.png[/img]

[h1]An Important Apology from resort CEO, Spasman[/h1]
Guests,
I regret to inform ALL of our guests the following information. Here at resort Le Somewhereland, we keep our inner workings transparent and keep you, the valued guest informed!

All future guests that attend our resort will need to have their progress reset.
Yes, your save file will be wiped, but it will happen to everyone! So think of it as a fresh start instead of starting over.

Experienced guests have nothing to learn from bots, zombie AI and survival enemies. When you reach level 80, you will no longer gain XP from our staff members! You will only be able to get XP from, ahem, "interacting" with the other guests!
So get out there and socialize!

For those certain guests out and about looking to do some, uhm, "business" with me, you can now encounter me in Survival mode! It's totally me, I swear. Not a robot.

Lastly, resort maintenence is still going on, but you can expect to see our new faculties to open up before August!

Thank you to all guests, current and shopping! What you have just read is merely a taste.. remember to check the change log when its released! Please consider coming to our resort, or coming back on your next planned holiday.

- Spasman, CEO



[h1][url=http://spasmangames.com/boringman/]Play Boring Man - Online Tactical Stickman Combat[/url][/h1]

notes.title: More servers!
notes.notes:
Hello! Today you may notice I'm hosting 7 servers. Thanks to your contributions by buying Premium, I was able to afford upgrading to business class internet which is nearly triple the speeds of residential. (I am a business, I guess...)

7 servers may not be permanent, it still may be too much or in the rare case be too little and we could do more! But only testing can find out.

If I find that too many servers are up for the bandwidth, I'll cut off the ones with a struggling population. If servers are having a stuggling population period, I'll change them out for a creative mutator game mode or something.

So if you've been frustrated with being unable to join servers in the past, well, I doubt you'll have that problem now. Come play!

notes.title: Tournament Survey
notes.notes:
Hey guys. Some of you guys seem itchin for a competitive scene so I'm gonna try to pitifully jump start one.

I'm thinking about running a tournament but I have no idea what would be fair or unfair. I have no idea what would make it fun to play and interesting to watch, hell, I don't even know how many people actually would want to join!

So I made this survey: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1LOUbwXOuANiTu_4658NPpyPg77pr9kNO9KQBzy0GBkI/edit

Please fill it out if you're interested in a tourney (or strongly disinterested I guess..)

I'll try to collect data and make up some sets of rules.

I'm not going to accept any custom maps requests at this time, sorry.

notes.title: Boring Man v1.1.7.1 is now available
notes.notes:
I actually really sat down and played my own game last night and all evening today, and realized I've been neglecting a weapons house cleaning quite a bit. I've been so caught up with work and fixing the netcode I forgot to fix the weapons themselves.

So a bit of weapon rebalancing was in order. If a weapon got a nerf, it was because I felt like using it was a mindless activity you could farm a lot of kills with or hurt the game balance in its own special way.

Any buffs I gave to a weapon I felt like I was struggling far too much to keep a decent kdr with (compared to the regular or OP weapons)

Changelog:

Fixed/Changed

- Pingable servers are now sorted to the top (correctly..)

notes.title: Pings removed from server list (v1.1.5.1)
notes.notes:
I have removed pings from the server list in v1.1.5.1 as it was confusing the netcode and making players unable to connect to most servers.

This isn't a guarantee all you can join most servers now (port forwards are still required), but it should have improved it. The server would get confused with pings from the server list as real players, so when the player would try to join after receiving a ping, the server would think two players joined and then think they're bugged clones and kick them out.

Server list pings were actually a fairly new feature for the Steam version, for a long time B-Man didn't have pings on the server list.. so I guess we're going back to that.

Due to the game's small population, I don't think this will be too missed. However if you are a server owner, I strongly recommend putting your region somewhere in your server name so close-ish people can find you.

I have also manually subtracted ~27ms from ping times, because extensive testing on my part has revealed it takes this much time to receive a ping logically, not through the internet. The netcode performance won't have a increase, its just showing a better ball park average of what your ping is on the server.

Anyways I apologize for the shoddy workmanship on this game. It's my first online game. and I apologize for adding a nice feature and then removing it. If I find an alternative method to server list pinging, then I will defnitely use it, but that feature will be gone for now as it was affecting the game too much. Yes it will be slightly more difficult to weed through the not-portforwarded garbage but it's the best I can do for now.

ONE MORE TIME, this won't solve *all* TCP Error problems, you will still get them, but I think it will improve a little.

- Spasman

notes.title: Help test Boring Man!
notes.notes:
Posting this again because beta mode is actually ready now...

I've created a new B-Man branch that let you download an early version of the game's next update. 

I will use this branch to experiment fixes and test features and possibly find more bugs. It's entirely optional and available to everyone. 

Some pros and cons about playing in beta mode: 

Pros: 
See bug fixes and new content early 

Smaller population so maybe more likely to get into a server 

Support Spasman in his time of need and become a hardcore B-Man fan. 

I will also be paying attention to my one server that will be up quite a bit, so it's a good chance to get the achievement for killing me.
Cons: 
Unstable 

Some maps are modified but not whitelisted yet, so you may not get XP. The game will warn you if this is happening.
The game will also state the version you have is "outdated" but in fact will display a later number then the current version. This is natural. 

Anyways, if you'd like to help test the new version, this is how you do it: 

1. Open your steam library, right click B-Man 

2. Select "Properties" 

3. Select the Betas tab 

4. Click the drop down and select "beta", close the window 

Steam should automatically reinstall the game, but if it doesn't you should either reinstall it yourself or restart Steam. 

If you don't see a betas tab, then you will need to restart Steam.

If you wish to go back to the stable version (I use that term lightly), simply follow the instructions above again but choose "NONE" instead of "beta". 

I will be running 1 test server in beta mode, but you're welcome to run a server yourself as well. The server list doesn't show servers that match your game version, so it will appear more empty then usual. 

My server will be ran from the game's dev build, and I will also be shutting it down a lot to make tweaks to the code. 

Thank you for helping me test, I can do most game developer stuff by myself but it's difficult to test without a dedicated Q/A team.

notes.title: Hello! Thanks for playing.
notes.notes:
Crazy first day, I sincerely thought I was going to float off the front page without being noticed.. (kind of wishing I did at this point..)

I'd just like to make a small technical FAQ that maybe you'll read before you yell at me in the reviews section.

[i]Why can't I join any servers?[/i]
Probably because the host hasn't portforwarded, and there are a lot of them. They play the game by themselves and have no idea they're on the server list, so they don't configure their network to accept players.

I turned off Lobby on Host by default, but there are still stragglers who have the original config.

As a tip, just avoid trying to join any servers that have a ping of "N/A" entirely, unless told otherwise. My servers (Spasman's Servers) are configured and are joinable

[i]I keep getting TCP Error 4[/i]
I know!! How infuriating!! This happens when there is a bugged connection on a server. Earlier I uploaded a small hotfix that clears any bugged connections every 10 seconds, so if you get this error now, just wait a little bit before trying to join again. Hopefully I'll find a better fix for this.

[i]My screen is freaking out or whatever[/i]
This is a borderless window extension I'm using that isn't working out too well. It will be removed in the next update and hopefully resolve most of your issues. I also recommend turning off screen shake in video options, that might help too.

[i]Go back to newgrounds[/i]
Okay. [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7WP6BTTaXwY]Here is video proof of me going back to newgrounds[/url]

If you really like this game but can't pay for the DLC for whatever reason, just leave me a nice review and I'll be happy. Positive reviews cheer me up.
